units.unitName: Unit 1 - Introduction to Financial Services Environment and Products (ITFS)

topics.summary: Covers how the UK financial services industry channels money between savers, borrowers, businesses and government, and how core institutions support the economy. For exam purposes, this topic links industry structure to monetary policy, taxation and consumer outcomes.
keyPoints: Financial services transfer funds between surplus and deficit sectors.
Retail, wholesale and market institutions play different roles.
Bank of England influences stability, inflation and interest rates.
mustMemories: Understand roles of BoE, government, mutuals and proprietary firms.
Know inflation, taxation and welfare links to personal finance decisions.

topics.topicName: Asset Classes and Core Financial Products
topics.summary: Reviews deposits, bonds, equities, property and pooled investments, plus savings wrappers and protection products. Exam questions often test product features, risk, return, liquidity and tax treatment.
keyPoints: Cash and money market assets are usually lower risk and more liquid.
Equities and property can offer growth but with volatility and capital risk.
Collectives spread risk but still depend on underlying assets.
mustMemories: ISA annual allowance and tax-wrapper principles.
Difference between gilts, bonds, shares and pooled funds.

mcqs.q: 2024/2025 What is 'better than best' advice?
opts: Advice which shows a product to be better than any other.
Advice for which an adviser shares his remuneration,
A recommendation by a tied agent that a client should consult an IFA.
Extra careful advice arising from a conflict of interest. 267 CeMAP 1 Revision Guide
mcqs.ex: Correct answer: Extra careful advice arising from a conflict of interest. 267 CeMAP 1 Revision Guide. Based on the CeMAP 1 specimen exam answer key.

mcqs.q: 2024/25 Income Tax Personal Allowance 是多少？
mcqs.ex: 答案：£12,5702024/25年度Personal Allowance為£12,570。收入超過£100,000，PA按每£2收入減少£1遞減。

mcqs.q: CGT Annual Exempt Amount 是多少？
mcqs.ex: 答案：£12,300CGT年度免稅額£12,300（2024/25）。基本稅率納稅人18%，高薪納稅人28%。

mcqs.q: IHT Nil-Rate Band 是多少？
mcqs.ex: 答案：£325,000IHT零稅率帶£325,000。超過部分40%稅率。Residence Nil-Rate Band額外£175,000。

mcqs.q: SDLT首置免稅額是多少？
mcqs.ex: 答案：£250,000首置買家SDLT免稅額£250,000（房產價值£425,000以下部分）。

mcqs.q: 2024/25 ISA 訂閱上限是多少？
mcqs.ex: 答案：£20,0002024/25年度ISA訂閱上限£20,000。Cash ISA/Stocks & Shares ISA/Innovative Finance ISA可自由分配。

topics.summary: Focuses on life assurance, critical illness, income protection, general insurance, pensions and basic mortgage product knowledge. Questions usually test product purpose, event triggers and suitability for client needs.
keyPoints: Protection products meet different risks: death, illness, incapacity and loss.
Pension and annuity products convert long-term savings into retirement income.
Mortgage products differ by rate structure and repayment method.
mustMemories: Know the purpose of term assurance, whole of life, CIC, IP and MPPI.
Know common mortgage repayment vehicles and rate types.

mcqs.q: 以下哪種產品不受 FSCS 保障？
opts: 銀行存款
政府債券
P2P借貸
人壽保險
mcqs.ex: 答案：P2P借貸P2P借貸不受FSCS保障。銀行存款受£85,000保障，政府債券由政府擔保。

mcqs.q: Critical Illness Cover 的主要特點是？
opts: 每月支付固定金額直到死亡
確診指定疾病即時支付一筆過款項
支付醫療費用實報實銷
只保障意外死亡
mcqs.ex: 答案：確診指定疾病即時支付一筆過款項Critical Illness Cover確診指定嚴重疾病時一次性支付款項。建議以Trust形式寫入。

mcqs.q: Annuity（年金）的主要特點是？
opts: 永久支付直到投保人死亡
支付固定年期
可隨時提取
投資性質為主
mcqs.ex: 答案：永久支付直到投保人死亡Annuity在投保人生存期間支付，死亡後停止（除非有保證期）。

mcqs.q: With-Profits Endowment 的紅利分配方式是？
opts: 固定利率
平滑回報（smoothing）
每年遞增
與通脹掛鉤
mcqs.ex: 答案：平滑回報（smoothing）With-Profits Endowment通過平滑機制分配紅利，減少回報波動。

topics.topicName: Financial Planning Process and Client Advice
topics.summary: Explains fact-finding, prioritising needs, assessing risk and matching suitable solutions to client objectives. The exam tests advice logic, affordability, reviews and the client relationship.
keyPoints: Fact-finds capture goals, assets, liabilities, dependants and risk profile.
Advice must reflect affordability, attitude to risk and capacity for loss.
Regular review matters because circumstances and product suitability change.
mustMemories: Contents of a fact-find and review process.
Difference between attitude to risk and suitability.

mcqs.q: Kevin has approached Colin to discuss pensions following a referral from Kevin's client Darren. Colin asks who suggested that he might be interested in pensions. What should Kevin do?
opts: Decline to answer as he has been requested not to divulge Darren's name
Give Darren's name having obtained his permission at the outset to do so.
Give Darren's name and explain briefly the nature of Darren's business with the company.
State that he must first obtain the clients permission to reveal his name.
mcqs.ex: Correct answer: Give Darren's name having obtained his permission at the outset to do so.. Based on the CeMAP 1 specimen exam answer key.

units.unitName: Unit 2 - UK Financial Services and Regulation (UKFS)

topics.summary: Covers contract, agency, ownership, wills, intestacy, powers of attorney and insolvency concepts used in financial advice. Questions often hinge on legal capacity, authority and estate consequences.
keyPoints: Advice depends on who owns assets and who has authority to act.
Intestacy and wills affect estate distribution.
Bankruptcy and insolvency can limit product access and planning choices.
mustMemories: Agency, contract capacity, joint ownership and intestacy basics.
Power of attorney and personal representatives roles.

mcqs.q: Intestacy（無遺囑）下，配偶優先繼承權是多少？
opts: 全部遺產
第一 £250,000 + 一半剩餘
一半遺產
mcqs.ex: 答案：第一 £250,000 + 一半剩餘配偶優先：第一£250,000遺產 + 剩餘財產的一半。另一半由子女均分。

topics.summary: Introduces the UK regulatory framework, especially the FCA and PRA, along with authorisation, supervision, principles, conduct expectations and Consumer Duty. This is a high-weight exam area in UKFS.
keyPoints: FCA focuses on conduct, markets and consumer protection; PRA focuses on prudential soundness.
Consumer Duty strengthens expectations on outcomes, value, understanding and support.
SMCR allocates accountability to senior managers and certified staff.
mustMemories: FCA/PRA objectives, Principles for Businesses and Consumer Duty outcomes.
AP/AR, authorisation and SMCR essentials.
commonExamPoints: SMCR and fair treatment of customers

mcqs.q: FCA的兩個法定目標是什麼？
opts: Market integrity + Consumer protection
Price stability + Economic growth
Safety + Soundness
Competition + Innovation
mcqs.ex: 答案：Market integrity + Consumer protectionFCA法定目標：①市場誠信 ②消費者保護。PRA目標才是Safety and soundness。

mcqs.q: Consumer Duty包含多少個 Outcomes？
opts: 2個
3個
4個
5個
mcqs.ex: 答案：4個 OutcomesConsumer Duty（2023年7月生效）4個outcomes：①Products & Services ②Price & Value ③Consumer Understanding ④Consumer Support。

mcqs.q: SMCR中，Senior Managers需要準備什麼文件？
opts: Compliance statement
Statement of Responsibilities
Conduct rules certification
Regulatory business plan
mcqs.ex: 答案：Statement of ResponsibilitiesSenior Managers必須有Statement of Responsibilities，明確列出負責的監管職能。

mcqs.q: FOS對金融投訴的最高補償限額是多少？
mcqs.ex: 答案：£430,000（2024年4月起）FOS最高補償上限£430,000。FSCS存款保障上限£85,000。

mcqs.q: FSCS存款保障計劃的上限是多少？
mcqs.ex: 答案：£85,000 per personFSCS對存款保障上限£85,000 per person（每個金融機構）。

mcqs.q: GDPR最高罰款是多少？
opts: £5 million
£10 million
£17.5 million or 4% 全球營業額
£50 million
mcqs.ex: 答案：£17.5 million 或 4% 全球營業額（以較高者為準）GDPR兩級罰款：最高級£17.5m/4%營業額；較低級£8.7m/2%營業額。

mcqs.q: POCA 2002中，MLRO的職責是什麼？
opts: Marketing compliance
Money Laundering Reporting Officer（洗黑錢舉報主任）
Mortgages product layout
Regulatory capital management
mcqs.ex: 答案：Money Laundering Reporting Officer（MLRO）POCA 2002要求任命MLRO，負責監督反洗黑錢合規、接收內部SAR、向外匯報可疑交易。

topics.topicName: Conduct of Business, MCOB and Consumer Credit
topics.summary: Deals with disclosure, promotions, client types, suitability, mortgage conduct and consumer credit rules. Exam questions usually test when disclosures are needed and how firms should behave.
keyPoints: Clear, fair and not misleading communication is a core rule.
MCOB governs regulated mortgage business; CONC covers consumer credit.
Disclosure and status must be explained before advice or sale progresses.
mustMemories: KFI/ESIS concepts, financial promotions standard, cancellation/disclosure basics.
Difference between MCOB, ICOBS and CONC.

mcqs.q: Consumer Insurance Act 2012的主要改變是？
opts: 強制所有保險使用標準表格
消費者只需回答被問及的問題
所有保費必須公開
保險投訴時效延長至3年
mcqs.ex: 答案：消費者只需回答被問及的問題Consumer Insurance Act 2012改變了披露責任：消費者只需如實回答被問及的問題。

mcqs.q: Consumer Credit Act 1974監管的信貸協議是？
opts: 所有公司借貸
非公司借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000
所有住宅按揭
所有商業貸款
mcqs.ex: 答案：非公司借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000CCA 1974監管：借款人是個人 + 信用額低於£25,000。住宅按揭受FSMA + MCOB監管。

mcqs.q: Consumer Credit Act 1974監管的信貸協議門檻是？
mcqs.ex: 答案：£25,000CCA 1974監管信用額低於£25,000的非公司借款人信貸協議。

topics.topicName: Complaints, Compensation, AML and Data Protection
topics.summary: Covers complaint handling, the Financial Ombudsman Service, FSCS protection, anti-money laundering controls and data protection law. These topics are highly testable because they combine rules, thresholds and firm obligations.
keyPoints: FOS handles eligible complaints; FSCS compensates when firms fail.
AML frameworks require due diligence, suspicious activity reporting and MLRO oversight.
GDPR and data protection rules govern lawful use and security of personal data.
mustMemories: FSCS/FOS purpose and AML reporting structure.
GDPR principles and data handling obligations.

mcqs.q: The main function of the financial services industry is to:
opts: Regulate banks
Transfer funds between individuals, businesses and government
Issue government bonds
Set interest rates
mcqs.ex: The FS industry transfers funds between those with surplus capital and those who need it.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is a retail banking institution?
opts: Investment bank
Building society
Wholesale bank
Pension fund
mcqs.ex: Building societies are retail banks owned by members, focusing on private customers.

mcqs.q: Peer-to-Peer lending is an example of:
opts: Disintermediation
Intermediation
Bank intermediation
Wholesale banking
mcqs.ex: P2P bypasses traditional banks = disintermediation (direct lender-borrower connection).

mcqs.q: Credit unions are regulated by which body?
opts: PRA
FCA
Bank of England
HMTreasury
mcqs.ex: Credit unions are regulated by the FCA under the Credit Unions Act 1979.

mcqs.q: The Bank of England acts as Lender of Last Resort to:
opts: Individual borrowers
Commercial banks
Retail customers
Government departments
mcqs.ex: BoE provides emergency liquidity to banks via the Discount Window Facility.

opts: FCA
MPC (Monetary Policy Committee)
PRA
HM Treasury
mcqs.ex: The MPC meets 8 times/year to set Bank Rate for the UK's monetary policy.

mcqs.q: The inflation target set by the UK government for the MPC is:
mcqs.ex: MPC targets 2% CPI inflation. If inflation deviates >1% from target, MPC must write to Chancellor.

mcqs.q: Government securities (Gilts) are traded in the:
opts: Money market
Capital market
Retail market
Interbank market
mcqs.ex: Gilts are long-term government bonds traded in the capital market (FTSE).

mcqs.q: Which of the following is NOT a money market instrument?
opts: Treasury Bill
Commercial Paper
UK Government Gilt
Bank Deposit
mcqs.ex: Gilts are capital market instruments (long-term >1yr); Treasury Bills are money market.

mcqs.q: A corporate bond with a fixed rate of interest paid semi-annually is called a:
opts: Equity
Eurobond
Convertible bond
Index-linked gilt
mcqs.ex: Eurobonds are international bonds, often fixed-rate, issued outside the borrower's home country.

mcqs.q: The main advantage of investing in equities is:

Capital growth potential
Low risk
Tax efficiency
mcqs.ex: Equities offer capital growth (and dividends) but carry higher risk than bonds.

mcqs.q: Commercial property is classified as what type of investment?
opts: Cash
Bonds
Real estate
Collective investment
mcqs.ex: Residential and commercial property are direct real estate investments.

mcqs.q: An ISA (Individual Savings Account) wrapper provides:
opts: Higher returns than normal accounts
Tax-free returns
Government guarantee
Fixed interest rates
mcqs.ex: ISAs provide a tax-free environment for savings (Cash ISA) and investments (Stocks & Shares ISA).

mcqs.q: The annual ISA subscription limit for 2024/25 is:
mcqs.ex: The adult ISA subscription limit is £20,000 for 2024/25 (all types combined).

mcqs.q: A With-Profits endowment policy aims to:
opts: Provide maximum returns immediately
Smooth returns via bonuses
Provide pure protection
Eliminate investment risk
mcqs.ex: With-profits policies smooth investment returns through regular and final bonuses.

opts: With-profits
Non-profit
Investment-linked
Capital guaranteed
mcqs.ex: Unit-linked = value moves with underlying fund; charges are higher but potential returns greater.

mcqs.q: The State Pension age in the UK is currently:
opts: 60 (women), 65 (men)
66 for both
67 for both
68 for both
mcqs.ex: State Pension age is 66 for both men and women (2020-2026), rising to 67 by 2028.

mcqs.q: A critical illness policy pays out:
opts: Monthly income on disability
A lump sum on diagnosis of a specified illness
Annuity payments
Death benefit only
mcqs.ex: Critical Illness Cover pays a lump sum on diagnosis of specified serious illness (e.g., cancer, heart attack).

mcqs.q: The FCA's primary operational objective is:
opts: Maximum profit for banks
Market integrity + Consumer protection
Low interest rates
Economic growth
mcqs.ex: FCA has three operational objectives: Consumer Protection, Market Integrity, and Competition.

mcqs.q: The PRA's primary objective is:
opts: Consumer protection
Safety and soundness of firms
Competition in markets
Financial inclusion
mcqs.ex: PRA (Prudential Regulation Authority) focuses on safety and soundness of deposit-takers.

Banks only
Insurance companies only
Investment firms only

opts: Annual bonus
Statement of Responsibilities
FCA approval number
Professional indemnity insurance
mcqs.ex: Senior Managers must have a Statement of Responsibilities, approved by the FCA.

opts: Maximum profits
Good outcomes for retail customers
Best execution only
Lowest costs always
mcqs.ex: Consumer Duty has 4 outcomes: Products & Services, Price & Value, Consumer Understanding, Consumer Support.

opts: Approved by the FCA before publication
Clear, fair and not misleading
Written in legal jargon
Filed with Companies House
mcqs.ex: FSMA 2000 requires all financial promotions to be clear, fair and not misleading.

The advisor must reject the client

Goods, services and digital content
Mortgages only
Insurance only

Speculation only
Car finance only

MCOB governs regulated mortgage business; CONC covers consumer credit.
Disclosure and status must be explained before advice or sale progresses.
mustMemories: KFI/ESIS concepts, financial promotions standard, cancellation/disclosure basics.
Difference between MCOB, ICOBS and CONC.

mcqs.q: Class 2 National Insurance Contributions for self-employed were:
opts: Still required at £3.45/week
Abolished from 2024/25
Set at £12.50/week
Voluntary only
mcqs.ex: Class 2 NICs abolished from 6 April 2024; self-employed still pay Class 4.

mcqs.q: The CGT annual exempt amount for 2024/25 is:
mcqs.ex: CGT AEA is £12,300 for 2024/25 (basic rate taxpayer; lower for higher rate).

mcqs.q: The IHT nil-rate band is:
mcqs.ex: IHT nil-rate band is £325,000; above this, rate is 40% (25% on certain trusts).

mcqs.q: Inheritance Tax is charged at 40% on the value of an estate above the:
opts: Annual exempt amount
Nil-rate band
Available nil-rate band
Residence nil-rate band
mcqs.ex: IHT at 40% applies to estate value above the nil-rate band of £325,000.

mcqs.q: The SDLT first-time buyer relief raises the threshold to:
mcqs.ex: FTB relief: no SDLT on first £425,000 (max £625,000 property), 5% on £425k-£625k.

mcqs.q: Consumer Insurance Act 2012的主要改變是？
opts: 強制所有保險使用標準表格
消費者只需回答被問及的問題
所有保費必須公開
保險投訴時效延長至3年
mcqs.ex:
答案：消費者只需回答被問及的問題
Consumer Insurance Act 2012改變了披露責任：消費者只需如實回答被問及的問題。 [From RG MCQ]

mcqs.q: Consumer Credit Act 1974監管的信貸協議是？
opts: 所有公司借貸
非公司借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000
所有住宅按揭
所有商業貸款
mcqs.ex:
答案：非公司借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000
CCA 1974監管：借款人是個人 + 信用額低於£25,000。住宅按揭受FSMA + MCOB監管。 [From RG MCQ]

mcqs.q: Consumer Credit Act 1974監管的信貸協議門檻是？
mcqs.ex:
答案：£25,000
CCA 1974監管信用額低於£25,000的非公司借款人信貸協議。 [From RG MCQ]

chapters.name: Complaints, Compensation, AML and Data Protection
chapters.summary: Covers complaint handling, the Financial Ombudsman Service, FSCS protection, anti-money laundering controls and data protection law. These topics are highly testable because they combine rules, thresholds and firm obligations.
keyPoints: FOS handles eligible complaints; FSCS compensates when firms fail.
AML frameworks require due diligence, suspicious activity reporting and MLRO oversight.
GDPR and data protection rules govern lawful use and security of personal data.
mustMemories: FSCS/FOS purpose and AML reporting structure.
GDPR principles and data handling obligations.

mcqs.q: Capital Gains Tax on residential property is now charged at:
mcqs.ex: Residential property CGT: 18% (basic) and 28% (higher/additional rate) from 2024/25.

mcqs.q: Annuities provide:
opts: A guaranteed lump sum
Income for a set term or lifetime
Capital growth
Tax-free withdrawals
mcqs.ex: An annuity pays income for life or a set term; once purchased, most are irrevocable.

mcqs.q: A relevant life assurance policy is:
opts: A personal policy
A business policy paying to the employer
A state benefit
A pension contribution
mcqs.ex: Relevant Life Assurance is a death-in-service benefit paid to the employer (then to dependants).

mcqs.q: Which is NOT a vulnerable client indicator?
opts: Health conditions affecting finances
Recent bereavement
Stable employment
Cognitive decline
mcqs.ex: Stable employment is generally positive; vulnerability flags include health, life events, financial stress.

mcqs.q: GDPR requires data breaches to be reported to ICO within:
opts: 24 hours
48 hours
72 hours
7 days
mcqs.ex: GDPR: report to ICO within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.

allMCQs.q: The main function of the financial services industry is to:
opts: Regulate banks
Transfer funds between individuals, businesses and government
Issue government bonds
Set interest rates
allMCQs.ex: The FS industry transfers funds between those with surplus capital and those who need it.

allMCQs.q: Which of the following is a retail banking institution?
opts: Investment bank
Building society
Wholesale bank
Pension fund
allMCQs.ex: Building societies are retail banks owned by members, focusing on private customers.

allMCQs.q: Peer-to-Peer lending is an example of:
opts: Disintermediation
Intermediation
Bank intermediation
Wholesale banking
allMCQs.ex: P2P bypasses traditional banks = disintermediation (direct lender-borrower connection).

allMCQs.q: Credit unions are regulated by which body?
opts: PRA
FCA
Bank of England
HMTreasury
allMCQs.ex: Credit unions are regulated by the FCA under the Credit Unions Act 1979.

allMCQs.q: The Bank of England acts as Lender of Last Resort to:
opts: Individual borrowers
Commercial banks
Retail customers
Government departments
allMCQs.ex: BoE provides emergency liquidity to banks via the Discount Window Facility.

allMCQs.q: Which body sets the Bank of England base rate?
opts: FCA
MPC (Monetary Policy Committee)
PRA
HM Treasury
allMCQs.ex: The MPC meets 8 times/year to set Bank Rate for the UK's monetary policy.

allMCQs.q: The inflation target set by the UK government for the MPC is:
allMCQs.ex: MPC targets 2% CPI inflation. If inflation deviates >1% from target, MPC must write to Chancellor.

allMCQs.q: Government securities (Gilts) are traded in the:
opts: Money market
Capital market
Retail market
Interbank market
allMCQs.ex: Gilts are long-term government bonds traded in the capital market (FTSE).

allMCQs.q: Which of the following is NOT a money market instrument?
opts: Treasury Bill
Commercial Paper
UK Government Gilt
Bank Deposit
allMCQs.ex: Gilts are capital market instruments (long-term >1yr); Treasury Bills are money market.

allMCQs.q: A corporate bond with a fixed rate of interest paid semi-annually is called a:
opts: Equity
Eurobond
Convertible bond
Index-linked gilt
allMCQs.ex: Eurobonds are international bonds, often fixed-rate, issued outside the borrower's home country.

allMCQs.q: The main advantage of investing in equities is:
opts: Guaranteed income
Capital growth potential
Low risk
Tax efficiency
allMCQs.ex: Equities offer capital growth (and dividends) but carry higher risk than bonds.

allMCQs.q: Commercial property is classified as what type of investment?
opts: Cash
Bonds
Real estate
Collective investment
allMCQs.ex: Residential and commercial property are direct real estate investments.

allMCQs.q: An ISA (Individual Savings Account) wrapper provides:
opts: Higher returns than normal accounts
Tax-free returns
Government guarantee
Fixed interest rates
allMCQs.ex: ISAs provide a tax-free environment for savings (Cash ISA) and investments (Stocks & Shares ISA).

allMCQs.q: The annual ISA subscription limit for 2024/25 is:
allMCQs.ex: The adult ISA subscription limit is £20,000 for 2024/25 (all types combined).

allMCQs.q: A With-Profits endowment policy aims to:
opts: Provide maximum returns immediately
Smooth returns via bonuses
Provide pure protection
Eliminate investment risk
allMCQs.ex: With-profits policies smooth investment returns through regular and final bonuses.

allMCQs.q: Unit-linked endowment policies are also known as:
opts: With-profits
Non-profit
Investment-linked
Capital guaranteed
allMCQs.ex: Unit-linked = value moves with underlying fund; charges are higher but potential returns greater.

allMCQs.q: The State Pension age in the UK is currently:
opts: 60 (women), 65 (men)
66 for both
67 for both
68 for both
allMCQs.ex: State Pension age is 66 for both men and women (2020-2026), rising to 67 by 2028.

allMCQs.q: A critical illness policy pays out:
opts: Monthly income on disability
A lump sum on diagnosis of a specified illness
Annuity payments
Death benefit only
allMCQs.ex: Critical Illness Cover pays a lump sum on diagnosis of specified serious illness (e.g., cancer, heart attack).

allMCQs.q: The FCA's primary operational objective is:
opts: Maximum profit for banks
Market integrity + Consumer protection
Low interest rates
Economic growth
allMCQs.ex: FCA has three operational objectives: Consumer Protection, Market Integrity, and Competition.

allMCQs.q: The PRA's primary objective is:
opts: Consumer protection
Safety and soundness of firms
Competition in markets
Financial inclusion
allMCQs.ex: PRA (Prudential Regulation Authority) focuses on safety and soundness of deposit-takers.

allMCQs.q: SMCR applies to:
opts: All financial services firms
Banks only
Insurance companies only
Investment firms only
allMCQs.ex: Senior Managers & Certification Regime applies to all FCA/PRA regulated firms.

allMCQs.q: Under SMCR, a Senior Manager must have a:
opts: Annual bonus
Statement of Responsibilities
FCA approval number
Professional indemnity insurance
allMCQs.ex: Senior Managers must have a Statement of Responsibilities, approved by the FCA.

allMCQs.q: The Consumer Duty requires firms to act to deliver:
opts: Maximum profits
Good outcomes for retail customers
Best execution only
Lowest costs always
allMCQs.ex: Consumer Duty has 4 outcomes: Products & Services, Price & Value, Consumer Understanding, Consumer Support.

allMCQs.q: A financial promotion must be:
opts: Approved by the FCA before publication
Clear, fair and not misleading
Written in legal jargon
Filed with Companies House
allMCQs.ex: FSMA 2000 requires all financial promotions to be clear, fair and not misleading.

allMCQs.q: The FSCS deposit protection limit is:
allMCQs.ex: FSCS protects deposits up to £85,000 per person per institution (from 2016).

allMCQs.q: The FOS compensation limit for claims is:
allMCQs.ex: FOS compensation limit is £430,000 (from April 2024) per upheld claim.

allMCQs.q: A vulnerability flag in a factfind indicates:
opts: The client is fraudulent
The client may need additional support or protection
The advisor must reject the client
The case needs special pricing
allMCQs.ex: Vulnerable clients (health, life events, financial difficulty) need additional care under Consumer Duty.

allMCQs.q: The Consumer Rights Act 2015 covers:
opts: Financial services only
Goods, services and digital content
Mortgages only
Insurance only
allMCQs.ex: Consumer Rights Act covers goods, services, and digital content — not financial services.

allMCQs.q: A regulated mortgage contract must be for:
opts: Business purposes only
Purchase or redemption of land
Speculation only
Car finance only
allMCQs.ex: A regulated mortgage (MCOB) requires: credit + land + borrower is an individual/trustee.

allMCQs.q: The Consumer Credit Act 1974 covers loans below:
allMCQs.ex: CCA 1974 regulates consumer credit agreements below £25,000 (and all consumer hires).

allMCQs.q: Class 2 National Insurance Contributions for self-employed were:
opts: Still required at £3.45/week
Abolished from 2024/25
Set at £12.50/week
Voluntary only
allMCQs.ex: Class 2 NICs abolished from 6 April 2024; self-employed still pay Class 4.

allMCQs.q: The CGT annual exempt amount for 2024/25 is:
allMCQs.ex: CGT AEA is £12,300 for 2024/25 (basic rate taxpayer; lower for higher rate).

allMCQs.q: The IHT nil-rate band is:
allMCQs.ex: IHT nil-rate band is £325,000; above this, rate is 40% (25% on certain trusts).

allMCQs.q: Inheritance Tax is charged at 40% on the value of an estate above the:
opts: Annual exempt amount
Nil-rate band
Available nil-rate band
Residence nil-rate band
allMCQs.ex: IHT at 40% applies to estate value above the nil-rate band of £325,000.

allMCQs.q: The SDLT first-time buyer relief raises the threshold to:
allMCQs.ex: FTB relief: no SDLT on first £425,000 (max £625,000 property), 5% on £425k-£625k.

allMCQs.q: Capital Gains Tax on residential property is now charged at:
allMCQs.ex: Residential property CGT: 18% (basic) and 28% (higher/additional rate) from 2024/25.

allMCQs.q: Annuities provide:
opts: A guaranteed lump sum
Income for a set term or lifetime
Capital growth
Tax-free withdrawals
allMCQs.ex: An annuity pays income for life or a set term; once purchased, most are irrevocable.

allMCQs.q: A relevant life assurance policy is:
opts: A personal policy
A business policy paying to the employer
A state benefit
A pension contribution
allMCQs.ex: Relevant Life Assurance is a death-in-service benefit paid to the employer (then to dependants).

allMCQs.q: Which is NOT a vulnerable client indicator?
opts: Health conditions affecting finances
Recent bereavement
Stable employment
Cognitive decline
allMCQs.ex: Stable employment is generally positive; vulnerability flags include health, life events, financial stress.

allMCQs.q: GDPR requires data breaches to be reported to ICO within:
opts: 24 hours
48 hours
72 hours
7 days
allMCQs.ex: GDPR: report to ICO within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.

allMCQs.q: GDPR maximum fine is the greater of:
opts: £500,000 or 1% global turnover
£10m or 2% global turnover
£17.5m or 4% global turnover
£1m or 0.5% global turnover
allMCQs.ex: GDPR Tier 2: up to £17.5m or 4% of total annual worldwide turnover.

allMCQs.q: FCA的兩個法定目標是什麼？
opts: Market integrity + Consumer protection
Price stability + Economic growth
Safety + Soundness
Competition + Innovation
allMCQs.ex:
答案：Market integrity + Consumer protection
FCA法定目標：①市場誠信 ②消費者保護。PRA目標才是Safety and soundness。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Consumer Duty包含多少個 Outcomes？
opts: 2個
3個
4個
5個
allMCQs.ex:
答案：4個 Outcomes
Consumer Duty（2023年7月生效）4個outcomes：①Products & Services ②Price & Value ③Consumer Understanding ④Consumer Support。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: SMCR中，Senior Managers需要準備什麼文件？
opts: Compliance statement
Statement of Responsibilities
Conduct rules certification
Regulatory business plan
allMCQs.ex:
答案：Statement of Responsibilities
Senior Managers必須有Statement of Responsibilities，明確列出負責的監管職能。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: FOS對金融投訴的最高補償限額是多少？
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£430,000（2024年4月起）
FOS最高補償上限£430,000。FSCS存款保障上限£85,000。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: FSCS存款保障計劃的上限是多少？
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£85,000 per person
FSCS對存款保障上限£85,000 per person（每個金融機構）。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: GDPR最高罰款是多少？
opts: £5 million
£10 million
£17.5 million or 4% 全球營業額
£50 million
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£17.5 million 或 4% 全球營業額（以較高者為準）
GDPR兩級罰款：最高級£17.5m/4%營業額；較低級£8.7m/2%營業額。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: POCA 2002中，MLRO的職責是什麼？
opts: Marketing compliance
Money Laundering Reporting Officer（洗黑錢舉報主任）
Mortgages product layout
Regulatory capital management
allMCQs.ex:
答案：Money Laundering Reporting Officer（MLRO）
POCA 2002要求任命MLRO，負責監督反洗黑錢合規、接收內部SAR、向外匯報可疑交易。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: 2024/25 Income Tax Personal Allowance 是多少？
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£12,570
2024/25年度Personal Allowance為£12,570。收入超過£100,000，PA按每£2收入減少£1遞減。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: CGT Annual Exempt Amount 是多少？
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£12,300
CGT年度免稅額£12,300（2024/25）。基本稅率納稅人18%，高薪納稅人28%。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: IHT Nil-Rate Band 是多少？
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£325,000
IHT零稅率帶£325,000。超過部分40%稅率。Residence Nil-Rate Band額外£175,000。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: SDLT首置免稅額是多少？
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£250,000
首置買家SDLT免稅額£250,000（房產價值£425,000以下部分）。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: 2024/25 ISA 訂閱上限是多少？
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£20,000
2024/25年度ISA訂閱上限£20,000。Cash ISA/Stocks & Shares ISA/Innovative Finance ISA可自由分配。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: 以下哪種產品不受 FSCS 保障？
opts: 銀行存款
政府債券
P2P借貸
人壽保險
allMCQs.ex:
答案：P2P借貸
P2P借貸不受FSCS保障。銀行存款受£85,000保障，政府債券由政府擔保。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Critical Illness Cover 的主要特點是？
opts: 每月支付固定金額直到死亡
確診指定疾病即時支付一筆過款項
支付醫療費用實報實銷
只保障意外死亡
allMCQs.ex:
答案：確診指定疾病即時支付一筆過款項
Critical Illness Cover確診指定嚴重疾病時一次性支付款項。建議以Trust形式寫入。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Annuity（年金）的主要特點是？
opts: 永久支付直到投保人死亡
支付固定年期
可隨時提取
投資性質為主
allMCQs.ex:
答案：永久支付直到投保人死亡
Annuity在投保人生存期間支付，死亡後停止（除非有保證期）。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: With-Profits Endowment 的紅利分配方式是？
opts: 固定利率
平滑回報（smoothing）
每年遞增
與通脹掛鉤
allMCQs.ex:
答案：平滑回報（smoothing）
With-Profits Endowment通過平滑機制分配紅利，減少回報波動。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Consumer Insurance Act 2012的主要改變是？
opts: 強制所有保險使用標準表格
消費者只需回答被問及的問題
所有保費必須公開
保險投訴時效延長至3年
allMCQs.ex:
答案：消費者只需回答被問及的問題
Consumer Insurance Act 2012改變了披露責任：消費者只需如實回答被問及的問題。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Consumer Credit Act 1974監管的信貸協議是？
opts: 所有公司借貸
非公司借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000
所有住宅按揭
所有商業貸款
allMCQs.ex:
答案：非公司借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000
CCA 1974監管：借款人是個人 + 信用額低於£25,000。住宅按揭受FSMA + MCOB監管。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Consumer Credit Act 1974監管的信貸協議門檻是？
allMCQs.ex:
答案：£25,000
CCA 1974監管信用額低於£25,000的非公司借款人信貸協議。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Intestacy（無遺囑）下，配偶優先繼承權是多少？
opts: 全部遺產
第一 £250,000 + 一半剩餘
一半遺產
allMCQs.ex:
答案：第一 £250,000 + 一半剩餘
配偶優先：第一£250,000遺產 + 剩餘財產的一半。另一半由子女均分。 [From RG MCQ]

topics.summary: Explains the legal and regulatory definition of regulated mortgage contracts, second charge lending and scope under MCOB. This is foundational because later advice rules depend on whether a case is regulated.
keyPoints: A mortgage may be defined differently in legal and regulatory contexts.
Regulated second charge loans and consumer buy-to-let need careful classification.
Advisers must identify whether MCOB applies before recommending or processing.
mustMemories: Know regulatory vs legal definitions and second-charge scope.

mcqs.q: 根據 FSMA 2000，抵押貸款的定義需要包含幾個要素？
opts: 2個
3個
4個
5個
mcqs.ex: 答案：4個要素FSMA 2000定義：①信用安排 ②以土地為抵押 ③借款人是個人或受托人 ④目的是購買或贖回住宅。

mcqs.q: 第二抵押貸款同時受什麼法規監管？
opts: 只有 FSMA
只有 CCA 1974
FSMA + MCOB
PRA only
mcqs.ex: 答案：FSMA + MCOB第二抵押同時受FSMA和Consumer Credit Act 1974（信用額低於£50,000時）監管。

topics.topicName: Types of Borrower and Borrowing Eligibility
topics.summary: Reviews residential, commercial, business, buy-to-let and vulnerable borrowers, plus factors that may restrict or prevent borrowing. Questions often test borrower category and lending difficulty.
keyPoints: Different borrower types are assessed under different rules and risk lenses.
Past credit problems, bankruptcy and vulnerability affect access and suitability.
Some applicants are ineligible or need specialist lending.
mustMemories: Know who can borrow, who struggles, and who cannot.

mcqs.q: Consumer Buy-to-Let（BTL）的定義是？
opts: 公司持有的出租房產
個人借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000
所有出租房產
海外投資者
mcqs.ex: 答案：個人借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000Consumer BTL：借款人是個人（非公司）+ 信用額低於£25,000，同時受MCOB和CCA 1974監管。

mcqs.q: 以下哪類人士通常不符合抵押貸款資格？
opts: 固定收入僱員
破產人士（Bankrupt）
自僱人士
退休人士
mcqs.ex: 答案：破產人士（Bankrupt）破產人士在破產令生效期間通常無法獲得新抵押貸款。破產記錄會嚴重影響信用評級。

mcqs.q: Mortgage-trapped borrowers是指什麼？
opts: 按時還款的借款人
無法轉按的借款人（現有利率低於市場）
信用評級極差的借款人
無收入的借款人
mcqs.ex: 答案：無法轉按的借款人（現有利率低於市場）Mortgage-trapped指借款人的現有抵押利率低於市場利率，無法通過轉按獲得更好條件。

topics.topicName: Property Tenure, Ownership and Legal Framework
topics.summary: Covers freehold, leasehold, commonhold, joint ownership, covenants, easements and land registration. This matters because property quality and title determine security for the lender.
keyPoints: Tenure affects rights, obligations and lender security.
Lease length, covenants and easements can affect value and marketability.
Title and registration issues can delay or block lending.
mustMemories: Freehold vs leasehold vs commonhold.
Joint ownership and title issues.

topics.summary: Explains how purchases proceed, including auctions, estate agency, conveyancing and SDLT. Exam questions often test process order, deadlines and buyer obligations.
keyPoints: Auction purchases require funding readiness before bidding.
Conveyancing protects legal title and lender security.
Transaction costs include SDLT, searches and legal fees.
mustMemories: Auction exchange/completion consequences.
Core purchase costs and conveyancing steps.

topics.topicName: Mortgage Applications, Income and Credit Assessment
topics.summary: Focuses on evidencing income, plausibility checks, DIP, credit assessment and underwriting logic. This is a major exam area and closely linked to affordability.
keyPoints: Income sources must be provable, sustainable and plausible.
Credit history, CCJs and conduct affect underwriting decisions.
A DIP is an indication, not a binding offer.
mustMemories: Income verification methods for employed and self-employed borrowers.
DIP status and credit assessment factors.

mcqs.q: Standard Variable Rate（SVR）的特點是？
opts: 利率固定不變
由貸方自行設定，可隨時變動
跟蹤基準利率
有利率上限

chapters.name: Regulatory Definition of Mortgage

Regulated second charge loans and consumer buy-to-let need careful classification.

mcqs.q: A regulated mortgage contract is defined under:
opts: Consumer Credit Act 1974
FSMA 2000
Financial Services Act 2012
Banking Act 2009
mcqs.ex: Regulated mortgages are defined under FSMA 2000 (MCOB).

mcqs.q: The 4 key elements of a regulated mortgage contract are:
opts: Credit + Land + Individual/Trustee + Purpose
Interest + Term + Amount + Security
Borrower + Lender + Rate + Repayment
All of the above
mcqs.ex: FSMA 2000: credit + land/immovable property + individual/trustee + purpose (purchase/ redemption).

mcqs.q: Under MCOB 11, affordability assessment must consider:
opts: Current interest rate only
The customer's ability to repay over the mortgage term
The property value
The lender's business model
mcqs.ex: MCOB 11.3: sustainable affordability across the full mortgage term, not just current rate.

mcqs.q: The MCOB stress test rate is the higher of:
opts: Current rate + 1% or 2%
Current rate + 2% or 4%
Current rate + 3% or 6%
BoE base rate + 2%
mcqs.ex: MCOB stress: current lender SVR + 3% OR the contract rate + 6%, whichever is higher.

mcqs.q: A Decision in Principle (DIP) is:
opts: A binding mortgage offer
An indication only, not legally binding
A formal valuation
Required by law before application
mcqs.ex: DIP/Agreement in Principle is an indication of lending amount — not legally binding.

3個
4個
5個

只有 CCA 1974
FSMA + MCOB
PRA only

第二抵押同時受FSMA和Consumer Credit Act 1974（信用額低於£50,000時）監管。 [From RG MCQ]

A lifetime mortgage

CCA 1974 only

An indication only, not legally binding
A formal valuation
Required by law before application
allMCQs.ex: DIP/Agreement in Principle is an indication of lending amount — not legally binding.

allMCQs.q: Leasehold property ownership means:
opts: You own the land and building forever
You own the building but lease the land for a long term
You share ownership of communal areas
You have a mortgage on a freehold property
allMCQs.ex: Leasehold = right to occupy for a fixed term (years); land owned by the freeholder.

allMCQs.q: The maximum ground rent under the Leasehold Reform (Ground Rent) Act 2022 is:
opts: £1 per year (peppercorn)
£100 per year
£250 per year
£500 per year
allMCQs.ex: 2022 Act: ground rent on new leases = £0 (peppercorn) for year 1; then capped at 1% of cap value.

allMCQs.q: Commonhold provides:
opts: A 999-year lease
Freehold ownership of a unit + shared common parts
A shared ownership scheme
A lifetime mortgage
allMCQs.ex: Commonhold = freehold unit + shared ownership of common parts; introduced to replace leasehold.

allMCQs.q: A second charge mortgage is regulated by:
opts: MCOB only
CCA 1974 only
Both MCOB and CCA 1974
Neither — purely commercial
allMCQs.ex: Second charge loans below £25,000 also regulated by CCA 1974, in addition to MCOB.

allMCQs.q: For sole traders and partnerships, a mortgage is regulated if:
opts: Always regulated
Never regulated
Credit is below £25,000 and for property up to 2 acres
The borrower has no other mortgages
allMCQs.ex: Business purpose loans for land > 2 acres may be exempt; sole traders need careful analysis.

allMCQs.q: MPPI typically covers:
opts: The full outstanding mortgage balance immediately
Monthly mortgage payments for 12-24 months
Life insurance benefit
Buildings insurance
allMCQs.ex: MPPI pays monthly mortgage payments (not the full balance) for a limited period (typically 12-24 months).

allMCQs.q: Critical illness cover is usually recommended to be written in:
opts: Company's name
A trust for family members
Personal name with FCA approval
Bank's name
allMCQs.ex: CIC written in Trust = proceeds paid directly to family, not subject to estate/IHT.

allMCQs.q: A relevant life assurance policy benefits:
opts: The individual's family directly
The employer (company pays, then to dependants)
The mortgage lender
The FCA directly
allMCQs.ex: Relevant Life Assurance is a death benefit paid to the employer; enhances employee benefits package.

allMCQs.q: For interest-only mortgages, the lender must ensure:
opts: Interest-only is cheaper overall
The borrower has a credible repayment vehicle
No affordability check is needed
The property is always freehold
allMCQs.ex: For interest-only: borrower must demonstrate credible repayment vehicle (ISA, endowment, pension, sale).

allMCQs.q: In a mortgage application, a County Court Judgment (CCJ) affects:
opts: Cannot get a mortgage with CCJ
May get a mortgage with higher deposit/rate
Only affects buy-to-let
Has no impact
allMCQs.ex: Lenders view CCJs seriously; older satisfied CCJs may be viewed more leniently.

allMCQs.q: A consumer buy-to-let (CBTL) mortgage is:
opts: Regulated by MCOB only
Not regulated at all
Regulated if credit below £25,000 and borrower is individual
Regulated if credit above £50,000
allMCQs.ex: CBTL: individual + credit below £25,000 = regulated by MCOB (Consumer Buy-to-Let).

allMCQs.q: MCOB 13 relates to:
opts: Mortgage applications
Arrears and possession
Disclosure requirements
Stress testing
allMCQs.ex: MCOB 13: Arrears Handling — requires lender to treat customers fairly, assess circumstances.

allMCQs.q: When a borrower goes into arrears, the lender's first step is to:
opts: Begin possession proceedings
Contact the borrower to understand the situation
Sell the debt to a collection agency
Reduce the interest rate
allMCQs.ex: MCOB 13: lender must contact borrower, understand circumstances, offer repayment plan.

allMCQs.q: Arrears of 3 months or more require:
opts: Immediate possession
Formal arrears management process
Automatic rate reduction
Lender to write off the debt
allMCQs.ex: MCOB 13: 3+ months arrears requires formal arrears handling and consideration of repayment options.

allMCQs.q: A Further Advance is:
opts: A second mortgage on a different property
Additional borrowing on the same property from existing lender
Changing the mortgage product with the same lender
Selling the property
allMCQs.ex: Further Advance = additional loan from existing lender on the same security (different from remortgage).

allMCQs.q: A remortgage is:
opts: Moving to a new lender with a better rate
Additional borrowing on same property
Selling the property and buying another
Converting interest-only to repayment
allMCQs.ex: Remortgage = switching from current lender to a new lender; requires full application process.

allMCQs.q: The local authority search Part 2 covers:
opts: Planning and building regulations
Highways and lighting
Environmental issues
All of the above
allMCQs.ex: LA Search Part 2 covers planning history, enforcement, building control — crucial for property due diligence.

allMCQs.q: A mortgage valuation is for:
opts: The borrower's benefit
The lender's benefit (ensuring security is adequate)
The estate agent's information
Required by law for all properties
allMCQs.ex: Valuation protects the LENDER's security; borrower should get a separate survey (RICS HomeReport).

allMCQs.q: The main factors affecting property value are:
opts: Location, condition, size, planning
Only the lender's opinion
Only comparable sales
The borrower's income
allMCQs.ex: Value drivers: location, size/condition, tenure, planning permission, market conditions.

allMCQs.q: Under the Estate Agents Act 1979, agents must:
opts: Guarantee a sale
Disclose conflicts of interest
Set minimum prices
Be FCA regulated
allMCQs.ex: EA Act: disclose any personal interest in a transaction; also requires client money protection.

allMCQs.q: Money laundering regulations require firms to have:
opts: A compliance officer only
CDD, MLRO, and suspicious activity reporting
No specific requirements
Automatic client approval
allMCQs.ex: MLRO (Money Laundering Reporting Officer), Customer Due Diligence, and SAR reporting required.

allMCQs.q: 根據 FSMA 2000，抵押貸款的定義需要包含幾個要素？
opts: 2個
3個
4個
5個
allMCQs.ex:
答案：4個要素
FSMA 2000定義：①信用安排 ②以土地為抵押 ③借款人是個人或受托人 ④目的是購買或贖回住宅。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: 第二抵押貸款同時受什麼法規監管？
opts: 只有 FSMA
只有 CCA 1974
FSMA + MCOB
PRA only
allMCQs.ex:
答案：FSMA + MCOB
第二抵押同時受FSMA和Consumer Credit Act 1974（信用額低於£50,000時）監管。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: MCOB 11 的核心要求是什麼？
opts: 產品披露
負擔能力評估
利率計算
投訴處理
allMCQs.ex:
答案：負擔能力評估
MCOB 11是負擔能力評估章節，確保借款人在整個貸款期限內有可持續還款能力。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: MCOB規定的壓力測試利率是多少？
opts: 當前利率 + 1%
當前利率 + 3% 或 6%（以較高者為準）
固定 5%
固定 3%
allMCQs.ex:
答案：當前利率 + 3% 或 6%（以較高者為準）
MCOB要求：當前利率 + 3% 或 + 6%，以較高者為準。這是MMR的核心要求。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: MCOB 13處理的是哪個範疇？
opts: 產品銷售前的建議
抵押貸款的術後管理
Arrears and Possessions（拖欠和收回）
抵押貸款的稅務
allMCQs.ex:
答案：Arrears and Possessions
MCOB 13處理拖欠和收回資產程序。貸方必須嘗試聯繫客戶、評估困難、提供還款方案。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: MCOB 4/4A要求在提供建議前必須提供什麼？
opts: Initial Disclosure（KFI/ESIS）
抵押估價報告
信用評級報告
法律意見書
allMCQs.ex:
答案：Initial Disclosure（KFI/ESIS）
MCOB 4/4A要求在提供建議前提供Key Features Illustration或ESIS文件。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Mortgage Market Review（MMR）的核心改變是？
opts: 降低首付要求
引入更嚴格的負擔能力評估
取消壓力測試
限制借款人數量
allMCQs.ex:
答案：引入更嚴格的負擔能力評估
MMR核心是引入更嚴格的負擔能力評估，包括壓力測試（2014年FCA改革）。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Decision in Principle（DIP）的性質是？
opts: 具有法律約束力的要約
僅為指示，不具法律約束力
最終審批決定
信用評估最終結果
allMCQs.ex:
答案：僅為指示，不具法律約束力
DIP是初步指示，僅表示貸方原則上願意借款，不構成法律約束力。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Consumer Buy-to-Let（BTL）的定義是？
opts: 公司持有的出租房產
個人借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000
所有出租房產
海外投資者
allMCQs.ex:
答案：個人借款人 + 信用額低於 £25,000
Consumer BTL：借款人是個人（非公司）+ 信用額低於£25,000，同時受MCOB和CCA 1974監管。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: 以下哪類人士通常不符合抵押貸款資格？
opts: 固定收入僱員
破產人士（Bankrupt）
自僱人士
退休人士
allMCQs.ex:
答案：破產人士（Bankrupt）
破產人士在破產令生效期間通常無法獲得新抵押貸款。破產記錄會嚴重影響信用評級。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Mortgage-trapped borrowers是指什麼？
opts: 按時還款的借款人
無法轉按的借款人（現有利率低於市場）
信用評級極差的借款人
無收入的借款人
allMCQs.ex:
答案：無法轉按的借款人（現有利率低於市場）
Mortgage-trapped指借款人的現有抵押利率低於市場利率，無法通過轉按獲得更好條件。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: MPPI（按揭付款保障保險）的保障範圍是？
opts: 一次性支付全部抵押貸款餘額
每月支付按揭還款（上限12-24個月）
支付房產估值費用
支付法律費用
allMCQs.ex:
答案：每月支付按揭還款（上限12-24個月）
MPPI支付每月按揭還款，通常有12-24個月上陸。不是一次性支付全部餘額。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Relevant Life Assurance 的特點是？
opts: 個人持有的壽險
公司為董事/員工購買，身故後支付予公司
可提取現金
保障失業
allMCQs.ex:
答案：公司為董事/員工購買，身故後支付予公司
Relevant Life Assurance由公司購買，身故後支付理賠予公司。可扣稅並豁免遺產稅。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Term Assurance 與 Whole of Life 的主要區別是？
opts: Term有現金價值，Whole of Life沒有
Term在期限後無任何價值，Whole of Life有儲蓄成分
兩者完全相同
Term只能個人持有
allMCQs.ex:
答案：Term在期限後無任何價值，Whole of Life有儲蓄成分
Term Assurance是純保障產品，期滿後如未索償，保障終止。Whole of Life包含儲蓄/投資成分。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Standard Variable Rate（SVR）的特點是？
opts: 利率固定不變
由貸方自行設定，可隨時變動
跟蹤基準利率
有利率上限
allMCQs.ex:
答案：由貸方自行設定，可隨時變動
SVR由各貸方自行設定，會根據市場情況變動。借款人可自由轉按，但通常有退出費用。 [From RG MCQ]

allMCQs.q: Fixed Rate Mortgage 的特點是？
opts: 期限內利率固定，期滿後轉SVR
永遠不變
跟蹤通脹
無退出費用
allMCQs.ex:
答案：期限內利率固定，期滿後轉SVR
Fixed Rate在固定期限內還款固定，期滿後自動轉為SVR或重新定價。通常有提前還款費用（ERC）。 [From RG MCQ]

units.unitName: Mortgage Payment Methods, Products and Post-Completion

topics.summary: Explains capital-and-interest, interest-only, part-and-part and the vehicles used to repay capital over time. Questions test certainty, risk and suitability of each method.
keyPoints: Capital-and-interest reduces the balance over the term.
Interest-only needs a credible repayment vehicle.
Part-and-part mixes certainty with flexibility.
mustMemories: Know repayment methods and common vehicles like ISAs, pensions and endowments.

mcqs.q: Capital & Interest 還款方式的特點是？
opts: 每月只還利息
每月還款包含本金和利息，比例隨時間改變
還款金額每年遞增
還款期限不固定
mcqs.ex: 答案：每月還款包含本金和利息，比例隨時間改變Capital & Interest每月還款固定，但利息部分減少，本金部分增加。

mcqs.q: Interest-Only 抵押貸款需要配備什麼？
opts: 無需任何準備
還款車輛（repayment vehicle）
全額保險
固定收入證明
mcqs.ex: 答案：還款車輛（repayment vehicle）Interest-Only每月只還利息，到期一次性還本金。還款車輛可以是ISA、Endowment、Pension等。

mcqs.q: Part-and-Part 抵押貸款的特點是？
opts: 同時有還本和只還利息部分
只還利息
只還本金
彈性還款
mcqs.ex: 答案：同時有還本和只還利息部分Part-and-Part同時包含Capital & Interest和Interest-Only兩部分，借款人可選擇各部分的比例。

topics.topicName: Mortgage Product Types and Rate Structures
topics.summary: Covers variable, tracker, fixed, capped, discounted, offset and flexible mortgages. Exam questions usually compare payment stability, risk and product trade-offs.
keyPoints: Different rate structures change payment certainty and interest-rate exposure.
Some products reduce initial cost but may cost more later.
Offset and flexible features may suit cash-rich or variable-income clients.
mustMemories: Core features of fixed, tracker, SVR, capped and offset products.

topics.summary: Includes buy-to-let, guarantor, right to buy, self-build, shared ownership, Help to Buy, foreign currency and Islamic mortgages. The exam tests matching specialist products to borrower circumstances.
keyPoints: Specialist products solve niche borrowing needs but add complexity.
Affordable housing schemes have distinct deposit, equity and ownership rules.
Borrower purpose and property type drive suitability.
mustMemories: Shared ownership, Help to Buy, Right to Buy and BTL basics.

mcqs.q: Help to Buy Equity Loan的最高比例（倫敦外）是？
mcqs.ex: 答案：20%（倫敦外）/ 40%（倫敦）Help to Buy：倫敦外最高20%，倫敦最高40%。政府部分免首5年利息。

mcqs.q: Shared Ownership 的 staircasing 是指？
opts: 逐步增購房屋股份
逐步減少還款
樓梯維修責任
房產估值的樓層調整
mcqs.ex: 答案：逐步增購房屋股份（incremental purchase）Staircasing允許Shared Ownership業主逐步增購更多股份（每次至少增購10%），直至完全擁有。

mcqs.q: Right to Buy 的折扣上限是多少？
opts: 無上限
mcqs.ex: 答案：£75,000（倫敦外）/ £100,000（倫敦）Right to Buy優惠最高折扣：倫敦外£75,000，倫敦£100,000（2021年起）。

mcqs.q: Retirement Interest-Only（RIO）抵押貸款的最低年齡是？
mcqs.ex: 答案：55歲RIO Mortgage要求借款人年滿55歲，無固定還款期限，只需持續還利息。

topics.summary: Focuses on life cover, MPPI, income protection, CIC, property insurance and landlord insurance around mortgage recommendations. Questions test needs analysis and product fit.
keyPoints: Protection should match the client risk being insured.
Some products pay lump sums; others replace income or mortgage payments.
Property-related insurance may be lender-required or highly advisable.
mustMemories: Difference between MPPI, IP, CIC, term assurance and buildings cover.

topics.summary: Reviews lender support, arrears handling, MCOB 13, possessions, sale shortfalls and borrower protections after completion. This is a heavily examined post-completion area.
keyPoints: Arrears management should seek fair, sustainable solutions before possession.
Possession is a last resort and heavily regulated.
Post-completion events include transfers, death, letting, redemption and remortgaging.
mustMemories: MCOB 13 principles and lender treatment of borrowers in arrears.

mcqs.q: MCOB 11 負擔能力評估要求評估借款人的什麼能力？
opts: 現時還款能力
整個貸款期限內的可持續還款能力
信用評級
年齡因素
mcqs.ex: 答案：整個貸款期限內的可持續還款能力MCOB 11要求評估借款人在整個貸款期限內的可持續還款能力，不僅是現時還款能力。

mcqs.q: MCOB中，消費者在申請前會收到哪份文件？
opts: KFI/ESIS
offer document
mortgage deed
valuation report
mcqs.ex: 答案：KFI/ESISMCOB 4/4A要求在提供建議前提供KFI或ESIS文件。

mcqs.q: MCOB 13規定，抵押貸款拖欠多久後視為 arrears？
opts: 1個月或1次還款未付
3個月或3次還款未付
6個月
12個月
mcqs.ex: 答案：1個月或1次還款未付MCOB 13規定，任何一次還款未付即構成arrears。貸方必須立即開始拖欠處理程序。

mcqs.q: 在 Arrears 處理中，貸方第一步應該？
opts: 立即啟動收回程序
嘗試聯繫借款人並評估困難
直接向法庭申請possession
忽視拖欠直至6個月
mcqs.ex: 答案：嘗試聯繫借款人並評估困難MCOB 13要求貸方首先嘗試聯繫借款人，了解拖欠原因，評估困難，提供還款方案。收回是最後手段。

mcqs.q: CeMAP 3 Case Study答題，第一步應該先做什麼？
opts: 先看整個Case Study的全部問題
先讀問題再到Case Study中找答案
先看最長的題目
先排除所有數字題
mcqs.ex: 答案：先讀問題再到Case Study中找答案Paul Archer建議：先讀問題（了解需要回答什麼），再回頭看Case Study資料，直接找相關信息。

mcqs.q: CeMAP 3 的「Domino Effect」是指？
opts: 所有題目必須按順序回答
題目之間有連鎖關係
每題答案是獨立的
答錯一題會影響其他題
mcqs.ex: 答案：題目之間有連鎖關係CeMAP 3的題目通常有連鎖性。第1題選擇產品，第2題通常與第1題相關，可能為你提供提示。

mcqs.q: CeMAP 3 試卷中的 lender 採用什麼借貸政策？
opts: 非常進取的借貸政策
市場上最優惠的產品
謹慎的借貸政策
只提供最貴的產品
mcqs.ex: 答案：謹慎的借貸政策CeMAP 3的lender不是市場上最進取的產品，而是完全合規、實行謹慎借貸政策的標準lender。

mcqs.q: CeMAP 3 建議每個 Case Study 用多少時間？
opts: 10分鐘
15分鐘
20分鐘
30分鐘
mcqs.ex: 答案：20分鐘Paul Archer建議每個Case Study用20分鐘。試卷有6個Case Studies，合共2小時。

topics.topicName: Redemption, Remortgaging and Ongoing Mortgage Administration
topics.summary: Covers transfers of equity, early redemption, remortgaging, second charge lending and managing the mortgage over time. Questions test how and why borrowers change or end arrangements.
keyPoints: Remortgaging can reduce cost, release equity or change features.
Transfers of equity affect ownership and sometimes SDLT.
Early repayment clauses and redemption rules must be understood before recommendation.
mustMemories: Redemption and remortgage basics, transfer of equity and second charges.

chapters.name: Repayment Methods and Repayment Vehicles
chapters.summary: Explains capital-and-interest, interest-only, part-and-part and the vehicles used to repay capital over time. Questions test certainty, risk and suitability of each method.
keyPoints: Capital-and-interest reduces the balance over the term.
Interest-only needs a credible repayment vehicle.
Part-and-part mixes certainty with flexibility.
mustMemories: Know repayment methods and common vehicles like ISAs, pensions and endowments.

mcqs.q: Capital and Interest (Repayment) mortgage means:
opts: Monthly payment covers interest only
Monthly payment covers both interest and capital
Monthly payment is flexible
No monthly payments are required
mcqs.ex: Repayment mortgage: each monthly payment reduces capital + pays interest; by end of term, debt is cleared.

mcqs.q: Interest-only mortgage requires:
opts: No monthly payments
A repayment vehicle to repay capital at end of term
A lower deposit
A fixed property value
mcqs.ex: Interest-only: borrower pays only interest monthly; capital repaid at end via ISA/endowment/pension/sale.

mcqs.q: A Part-and-Part mortgage:
opts: Splits the loan between repayment and interest-only portions
Is a type of second charge
Is only for buy-to-let
Requires two separate lenders
mcqs.ex: Part-and-Part: a portion repays capital + interest; remainder is interest-only with a repayment vehicle.

mcqs.q: Standard Variable Rate (SVR) mortgages:
opts: Have a fixed rate for the entire term
Rate is set by the lender and can change at any time
Cannot be changed by the lender
Always offer the lowest rate
mcqs.ex: SVR is set by each lender independently; can rise/fall at lender's discretion, not linked to BoE Base Rate.

mcqs.q: A Fixed Rate mortgage:
opts: Rate changes monthly
Rate is fixed for a set period (e.g., 2-5 years)
There is no ERC
Is always tracker-based
mcqs.ex: Fixed rate: repayment stays the same during the fixed period; after expiry, usually moves to SVR. ERC may apply.

mcqs.q: The main risk with Interest-Only mortgages is:
opts: Monthly payments are too high
The borrower may not have a adequate repayment vehicle
The lender will repossess immediately
The property will devalue
mcqs.ex: If the repayment vehicle fails or is insufficient, borrower may struggle to repay capital at end of term.

mcqs.q: Capital & Interest 還款方式的特點是？
opts: 每月只還利息
每月還款包含本金和利息，比例隨時間改變
還款金額每年遞增
還款期限不固定
mcqs.ex:
答案：每月還款包含本金和利息，比例隨時間改變

chapters.name: Mortgage Product Types and Rate Structures
chapters.summary: Covers variable, tracker, fixed, capped, discounted, offset and flexible mortgages. Exam questions usually compare payment stability, risk and product trade-offs.
keyPoints: Different rate structures change payment certainty and interest-rate exposure.
Some products reduce initial cost but may cost more later.
Offset and flexible features may suit cash-rich or variable-income clients.
mustMemories: Core features of fixed, tracker, SVR, capped and offset products.

mcqs.q: A Tracker mortgage tracks:
opts: The lender's SVR
Bank of England base rate plus a set margin
The consumer's income
A fixed government rate
mcqs.ex: Tracker = BoE Base Rate + X% (e.g., base + 1.5%). When base rate changes, tracker rate adjusts immediately.

mcqs.q: Help to Buy equity loan:
opts: Is a second charge on the property
Is interest-free for the first 5 years (on the equity loan portion)
Requires a 25% deposit
Is only available in Scotland
mcqs.ex: Help to Buy: government loan up to 20% (outside London) or 40% (London) of property value; interest-free first 5 years.

mcqs.q: Shared Ownership allows buyers to:
opts: Buy 100% of the property immediately
Buy a share (25-75%) and pay rent on the remaining portion
Only rent properties
Take an equity loan from the government
mcqs.ex: Shared Ownership: buy a share (minimum 25%) + pay subsidized rent on the housing association's share; can staircase up.

mcqs.q: 'Staircasing' in Shared Ownership means:
opts: Moving to a different property
Buying additional shares in the property
Reducing the rent paid
Selling the property
mcqs.ex: Staircasing = purchasing additional shares (up to 100%), reducing rent proportion accordingly.

mcqs.q: Right to Buy (RTB) applies to:
opts: Private tenants only
Housing association tenants only
Local authority secure tenants
All tenants in the UK
mcqs.ex: Right to Buy: LA secure tenants can buy their home at a discount (up to £102,700 outside London, £102,700-£127,200 inside London, 2024).

chapters.name: Specialist and Affordable Housing Products
chapters.summary: Includes buy-to-let, guarantor, right to buy, self-build, shared ownership, Help to Buy, foreign currency and Islamic mortgages. The exam tests matching specialist products to borrower circumstances.
keyPoints: Specialist products solve niche borrowing needs but add complexity.
Affordable housing schemes have distinct deposit, equity and ownership rules.
Borrower purpose and property type drive suitability.
mustMemories: Shared ownership, Help to Buy, Right to Buy and BTL basics.

mcqs.q: Retirement Interest-Only (RIO) mortgages require the borrower to be:
opts: Under 55
55 years or older
Employed full-time
First-time buyer
mcqs.ex: RIO: available to borrowers aged 55+; no fixed term — mortgage continues until death/entry to care.

mcqs.q: When assessing affordability for a Tracker mortgage:
opts: Only current rate matters
Stress test includes potential rate rises
No affordability check needed
Only employment status matters
mcqs.ex: Affordability must consider potential rate rises — stressed at current rate + 3% or +6% (MCOB 11).

mcqs.q: A lifetime mortgage (equity release) is:
opts: A standard repayment mortgage
An interest-only mortgage with no fixed term
A loan secured on property for older borrowers, repaid on death/care home entry
A government-backed scheme
mcqs.ex: Lifetime mortgages (HECM/-equity release): no monthly payments; interest compounds; repaid from estate sale on death.

mcqs.q: Under MCOB 13, when a borrower is in arrears, the lender MUST:
opts: Immediately start possession proceedings
Attempt to contact borrower and offer repayment options
Reduce the debt to zero
Transfer the mortgage to another lender
mcqs.ex: MCOB 13: fair arrears handling — lender must contact, assess circumstances, offer repayment plan before possession.

mcqs.q: A mortgage offer is issued after:
opts: The DIP is granted
Valuation is satisfactory and legal work is complete
The borrower accepts the rate
Immediately on application
mcqs.ex: Offer issued after satisfactory valuation + completed legal work + mortgage underwriting.

opts: 逐步增購房屋股份
逐步減少還款
樓梯維修責任
房產估值的樓層調整

chapters.name: Mortgage-Related Protection and Insurance
chapters.summary: Focuses on life cover, MPPI, income protection, CIC, property insurance and landlord insurance around mortgage recommendations. Questions test needs analysis and product fit.
keyPoints: Protection should match the client risk being insured.
Some products pay lump sums; others replace income or mortgage payments.
Property-related insurance may be lender-required or highly advisable.
mustMemories: Difference between MPPI, IP, CIC, term assurance and buildings cover.

mcqs.q: The Surveyor's Report differs from a Valuation in that:
opts: There is no difference

The Valuation is for the borrower's benefit
A Surveyor's Report is not recognized by lenders
mcqs.ex: RICS Surveyor's Report (Level 2/3) is for the buyer; Valuation is for the lender's security.

mcqs.q: Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) is required for:
opts: Commercial properties only

New builds only
Cash purchases only

mcqs.q: The Consumer Duty 2023 applies to:
opts: Mortgage brokers only
All FCA-regulated firms in retail financial services
Lenders only
Insurance firms only
mcqs.ex: Consumer Duty applies to ALL FCA-regulated firms providing retail financial services/products.

mcqs.q: MCOB 11 負擔能力評估要求評估借款人的什麼能力？
opts: 現時還款能力
整個貸款期限內的可持續還款能力
信用評級
年齡因素

答案：整個貸款期限內的可持續還款能力

chapters.name: Arrears, Possessions and Post-Completion Issues
chapters.summary: Reviews lender support, arrears handling, MCOB 13, possessions, sale shortfalls and borrower protections after completion. This is a heavily examined post-completion area.
keyPoints: Arrears management should seek fair, sustainable solutions before possession.
Possession is a last resort and heavily regulated.
Post-completion events include transfers, death, letting, redemption and remortgaging.
mustMemories: MCOB 13 principles and lender treatment of borrowers in arrears.

mcqs.q: The main difference between a Further Advance and a Remortgage is:
opts: No difference — same product

Both require a new property valuation
Both cancel the original mortgage

直接向法庭申請possession

mcqs.q: CeMAP 3 Case Study答題，第一步應該先做什麼？

chapters.name: Redemption, Remortgaging and Ongoing Mortgage Administration
chapters.summary: Covers transfers of equity, early redemption, remortgaging, second charge lending and managing the mortgage over time. Questions test how and why borrowers change or end arrangements.

caseStudies.caseSummary: Maurice is divorced and now lives with his new partner, Jane. caseStudies.caseSummary: Bryan, aged 48, is single and lives in a property valued at £125,000. He has an interest‐only mortgage on the property of £75,000 with 11 years left to run and is currently paying interest at the lender’s standard variable rate. The mortgage was to be repaid using a low‐cost endowment policy, which now has an estimated maturity value of only £50,000. Bryan is employed as an office manager by a local insurance company with a salary of £36,000 per annum. He is a member of the company’s occupational pension scheme, with a normal retirement age of 62, and he is committed to contributing 5% of gross salary to the pension scheme each month. He has regular overtime of £2,000 per annum and guaranteed bonuses of £4,000 per annum. Bryan insists that he wants to be sure that his mortgage payments CANNOT increase for as long as possible, as he believes the interest rates are going to rise in the next few years. He no longer wants his mortgage payments to be linked to a variable rate, nor take any further risks. As a classic car enthusiast, Bryan has the opportunity to buy a car that he has always wanted. The cost is £35,000, and as his savings amount to only £5,000, he has been trying to arrange a personal loan of £30,000 to buy the car. Bryan has a credit card balance of £2,000 which will remain.
